tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page background. Dark: blue-black night. Daylight: weathered paper/concrete.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, panels, FAQ items.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Sunk surfaces: Services panel, footer, code-like blocks.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings. 13.6–16.3:1 (dark), 13.7–17.1:1 (Daylight) on all surfaces.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, breadcrumbs. 7.2–8.6:1 (dark), 6.1–7.5:1 (Daylight).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Signal cyan: links, focus rings, active/selected states, live indicators. 10.3–12.5:1 (dark), 4.9–6.1:1 (Daylight).

tokens.name: contact
tokens.usage: Neon magenta. Reserved for the Contact action only (header button, contact blocks, chip-selection send). 5.2–6.3:1 (dark), 5.2–6.5:1 (Daylight) as text.

tokens.name: signal-tint
tokens.usage: Background of selected chips and hovered service cards. Always paired with a signal outline and a tick or icon; never the only sign of state. Ink stays readable on it.

tokens.name: contact-ink
tokens.usage: Text on a contact fill. 6.3:1 (dark), 6.8:1 (Daylight).

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Sodium amber: street lamps, rust and warm light in world zones; notices in reading zones. Rarely interactive. 9.1–10.9:1 (dark), 4.9–6.1:1 (Daylight).

tokens.name: hazard
tokens.usage: Hazard lime: world zones only (hazard tape, warning signs, toxic signage, glitch flashes). Never interactive, never in reading zones, never the only carrier of meaning. 13.5–16.3:1 (dark), 5.1–6.4:1 (Daylight).

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of every touchable control (buttons, chips, inputs, FAQ toggles). Meets 3:1 on all surfaces.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Decorative rules and card edges only; never a control's edge.

tokens.name: screen
tokens.usage: Inside CRT/monitor screens (hero TV, Control room demo, 404). Identical in both themes: screens stay dark.

tokens.name: phosphor
tokens.usage: Text and specks on screen. 13:1 on screen. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Minimum gap between touch targets; chip gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: label to field, list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone side gutter; card padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; tablet gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max content width.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of reading text.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height/width of any touch target.

tokens.name: target-main
tokens.usage: Height of main actions: Contact, Send, Connect them.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Sticky header height, desktop and phone.

tokens.name: bevel-sm
tokens.usage: Chips. Rendered as a 45° cut with corner-shape: bevel; fallback radius 2px.

tokens.name: bevel-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, icon buttons. corner-shape: bevel; fallback 2px.

tokens.name: bevel-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, FAQ items, screens' inner bezel. corner-shape: bevel; fallback 2px.

tokens.name: bevel-fallback
tokens.usage: Radius used where corner-shape is unsupported.

tokens.name: border-control-w
tokens.usage: Border width on every touchable control.

tokens.name: border-divider-w
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card edges.

tokens.name: focus-w
tokens.usage: Focus outline width (signal colour), offset 2px.
